title: New Update Available (v1.7.1)!
short_msg: A new faster Dhwani TTS update v1.7.1 is available! Double tap to view details and update now.
full_msg:
Greetings from Interested Technology for Blind!

A new update of Dhwani TTS (v1.7.1) is now live with important fixes:
1. Fixed the 0% stuck update download issue with fast auto-redirect support.
2. Added fast Indian voices with anti-stutter phoneme tuning.
3. Improved HD loudness and live 0% to 100% progress bar.

Tap 'Open Link / Download' below or use Check for Update to install the latest version!
update_notes: Version 1.7.1 fixes the 0% update download bug and includes fast Indian voices with HD clarity. Update now!
